title: SOCRadar ties LostTrust ransomware infrastructure to Eclipse and an AI-agent toolkit
date_note: SOCRadar's post gives only its publication day.
geo_basis: country; SOCRadar's post says most organizations named in the operators' material are in the US
summary: SOCRadar Research says it assesses with high confidence that one developer and one toolkit sit behind both an Eclipse ransomware server examined by Atos and the infrastructure it analysed, which also holds MetaEncryptor/LostTrust deployment scripts. SOCRadar says the operators use an AI agent over MCP for intrusion steps and that their material names organizations, mostly in the US. It adds that the operators still choose targets and run every step leading to extortion.
plain: SOCRadar researchers say they found attacker infrastructure linking the LostTrust and Eclipse ransomware brands, including an AI agent used for intrusion steps. Most organizations named in the operators' material are in the US.
exec: SOCRadar says LostTrust and Eclipse ransomware share one developer and toolkit, and names mostly US organizations in the operators' material.
action: SOCRadar advises validating and blocking the listed IPs, domains and hashes, and hunting for security-branded executables loading same-named DLLs from user-writable folders.

validation.note: Only SOCRadar's own post was read; the Atos analysis it cites was not read. Findings are SOCRadar's assessment and no victim has confirmed anything.

review.note: Compared title, Atos/Eclipse high-confidence link, MCP AI agent, US organizations, operator role, action, single-source status against SOCRadar post
